name: seepoo
description: Outil pédagogique CLI multi-langage de visualisation, manipulation et planification d'architecture Orientée Objet en temps réel

scripts.dev: node -e "import('node:child_process').then(({spawn})=>{const o={stdio:'inherit',shell:true};spawn('npm run dev:server',o);spawn('npm run dev:client',o);})"
scripts.build:client: cd src/client && svelte-kit sync && vite build
scripts.i18n:compile: cd src/client && paraglide-js compile --project ./project.inlang --outdir ./src/lib/paraglide --strategy localStorage --strategy baseLocale
scripts.test:ast: node --input-type=module -e "import { analyzeProject } from './src/server/astParser.js'; console.dir(await analyzeProject('./examples/tp-banque'), { depth: null });"
